title: Andi Eigenmann pays tribute to late mom Jaclyn Jose on her birthday
summary: Andi Eigenmann paid tribute to her late mother, veteran actress Jaclyn Jose, on Wednesday, October 21, what would have been Jose's 63rd birthday.
